name: mitm6
highlights: -l — Domain name to use as DNS search domain (default: use first DNS domain)
-4 — IPv4 address to send packets from (default: autodetect)
-6 — IPv6 link-local address to send packets from (default: autodetect)
-m — Custom mac address - probably breaks stuff (default: mac of selected interface)
-a — Do not advertise ourselves (useful for networks which detect rogue Router Advertisements)
-r — Authentication relay target, will be used as fake DNS server hostname to trigger Kerberos

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --localdomain
flags.description: Domain name to use as DNS search domain (default: use first DNS domain)

flags.name: --ipv4
flags.description: IPv4 address to send packets from (default: autodetect)

flags.name: --ipv6
flags.description: IPv6 link-local address to send packets from (default: autodetect)

flags.name: --mac
flags.description: Custom mac address - probably breaks stuff (default: mac of selected interface)

flags.name: --no-ra
flags.description: Do not advertise ourselves (useful for networks which detect rogue Router Advertisements)

flags.name: --relay
flags.description: Authentication relay target, will be used as fake DNS server hostname to trigger Kerberos auth

flags.name: --domain
flags.description: Domain name to filter DNS queries on (Allowlist principle, multiple can be specified.)

flags.name: --blocklist
flags.description: Domain name to filter DNS queries on (Blocklist principle, multiple can be specified.)

flags.name: --host-allowlist
flags.description: Hostname (FQDN) to filter DHCPv6 queries on (Allowlist principle, multiple can be specified.)

flags.name: --host-blocklist
flags.description: Hostname (FQDN) to filter DHCPv6 queries on (Blocklist principle, multiple can be specified.)

flags.name: --ignore-nofqdn
flags.description: Ignore DHCPv6 queries that do not contain the Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) option.
